A low hum of surrender rumbles up from its chest — silence follows.
Light scatters through its fading aura, a dying ember's gentle glow.
A final glimmer of wisdom flickers in the depths of its eyes before extinguishing.
Dust devils dance around the sudden stillness, as if nature itself is mourning.
